This '''duel''' took place in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Perilious]] between a [[Unidentified Jedi (Kardem's victim)|male Jedi]] and the former [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Vydel Dir'Nul]], who, unknowingly, was also the serial murderer Kardem. The duel ended when Dir'Nul, under the Kardem personality, murdered the Jedi sent after her by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]].

{{Battle-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The duel first appeared in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] "[[Dark Journey (comic story)|Dark Journey]]," which was featured in [[Star Wars Tales 17|''Star Wars Tales'' 17]] and written by [[Jason Hall]].
